revision.comment: 各国の式内社表の掲載。ただし、式内比定社は現在名神大社のみの状態、国史見在社・式外社も未掲載の状態。
revision.text:
'''土佐国の式内社一覧'''（とさのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[土佐国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社1座1社（名神大社）・小社20座20社の計21座21社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[安芸郡]]''' 3座（並小） |- |'''室津神社'''||ムロツノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''多気神社'''||タケ||小|||||||||| |- |'''坂本神社'''||サカモトノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[香美郡]]''' 4座（並小） |- |'''天忍穂別神社'''||アマノオシホワケノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''小松神社'''||コマツノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''深淵神社'''||フカフチノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''大川上美良布神社'''||-カハカミノミラフノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[長岡郡]]''' 5座（並小） |- |'''豊岡上天神社'''||トヨヲカノ-||小|||||||||| |- |'''朝峯神社'''||アサミネノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''殖田神社'''||ウヱタノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''小野神社'''||ヲノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''石土神社'''||イハツチ
イシツチ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[土佐郡]]''' 5座（大1座・小4座） |- |'''都佐坐神社'''||トサノ-||大||||||||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/570101.html] |- |'''葛木男神社'''||カツラキヲノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''葛木咩神社'''||カツラキヒメノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''郡頭神社'''||コホリツノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''朝倉神社'''||アサクラノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[吾川郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''天石門別安国玉主天神社'''||アマノイハトワケノヤスクニタマ-||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[幡多郡]]''' 3座（並小） |- |'''伊豆多神社'''||イツタノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''高知坐神社'''||タカシリノ-
タカチニ-||小|||||||||| |- |'''賀茂神社'''||カモノ||小|||||||||| |} {{-}} {{節stub}} == 式外社 == 当時すでに存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社。 === 国史見在社 === [[六国史]]に記載のある式外社。 {{節stub}} === その他 === 国史見在社以外の式外社。 {{節stub}} == 参考文献 == * 皇典講究所・全国神職会校訂[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年） - 近代デジタルライブラリー * [http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1273537 『延喜式 第2』]（日本古典全集刊行会、昭和4年） - 近代デジタルライブラリー == 外部リンク == * [http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjastate57.html 土佐国 式内社21座]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」） {{式内社一覧}} [[Category:土佐国の式内社|*]]

'''土佐国の式内社一覧'''（とさのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[土佐国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。
また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。

Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''土佐国の式内社一覧'''（とさのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[土佐国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。
また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。
== 式内社 == 『延喜式』神名帳では、大社1座1社・小社20座20社の計21座21社を記載。

In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} god name records but which are not listed in those records—the so‑called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}, a total of 21 groups In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}} god name records but which are not listed in those records—the so‑called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}} god name records but which are not listed in those records—the so‑called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a total of 21 groups comprising 1 major shrine group (dai-sha) and 20 minor shrine groups (shō-sha) are recorded. {{ill|List of Shikinai Shrines/Legend|de|List of Shikinai In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}} god name records but which are not listed in those records—the so‑called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a total of 21 groups comprising 1 major shrine group (dai-sha) and 20 minor shrine groups (shō-sha) are recorded. {{ill|List of Shikinai Shrines/Legend|de|List of Shikinai In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}} god name records but which are not listed in those records—the so‑called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|Immanuelle|zh|Immanuelle|12=draft}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|talk|zh|talk|12=draft}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinai Shrines in Tosa Province''' (土佐国の式内社一覧) is a list of {{ill|Shrine|de|Schrein|ja|神社|zh|神社|12=draft}}s found in {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}} Volumes 9 and 10 “Names of the Gods, Upper and Lower” ({{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}) – that is, the so‑called “{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}}” and its accompanying {{ill|Candidate Shrine|de|Kandidatschrein|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}s which are classified as being in {{ill|Tosa Province|de|Tosa-Province|ja|土佐国|zh|土佐国|12=draft}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}} god name records but which are not listed in those records—the so‑called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a total of 21 groups comprising 1 major shrine group (dai-sha) and 20 minor shrine groups (shō-sha) are recorded. {{ill|List of Shikinaisha/Legend|de|List of Shikinaisha/Legend|ja|凡例|zh|凡例|12=draft}} {| “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}} god name records but which are not listed in those records—the so‑called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a total of 21 groups comprising 1 major shrine group (dai-sha) and 20 minor shrine groups (shō-sha) are recorded. {{ill|List of Shikinaisha/Legend|de|List of Shikinaisha/Legend|ja|凡例|zh|凡例|12=draft}} {| Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|Immanuelle|zh|Immanuelle|12=draft}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|talk|zh|talk|12=draft}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinai Shrines in Tosa Province''' (土佐国の式内社一覧) is a list of {{ill|Shrine|de|Schrein|ja|神社|zh|神社|12=draft}}s found in {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}} Volumes 9 and 10 “Names of the Gods, Upper and Lower” ({{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}) – that is, the so‑called “{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai Schrein|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|12=draft}}” and its accompanying {{ill|Candidate Shrine|de|Kandidatschrein|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}s which are classified as being in {{ill|Tosa Province|de|Tosa-Province|ja|土佐国|zh|土佐国|12=draft}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}} god name records but which are not listed in those records—the so‑called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a total of 21 groups comprising 1 major shrine group (dai-sha) and 20 minor shrine groups (shō-sha) are recorded. {{ill|List of Shikinaisha/Legend|de|List of Shikinaisha/Legend|ja|凡例|zh|凡例|12=draft}} {| In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}} god name records but which are not listed in those records—the so‑called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a total of 21 groups comprising 1 major shrine group (dai-sha) and 20 minor shrine groups (shō-sha) are recorded. {{ill|List of Shikinaisha/Legend|de|List of Shikinaisha/Legend|ja|凡例|zh|凡例|12=draft}} {| In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}} god name records but which are not listed in those records—the so‑called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a total of 21 groups comprising 1 major shrine group (dai-sha) and 20 minor shrine groups (shō-sha) are recorded. {{ill|List of Shikinaisha/Legend|de|List of Shikinaisha/Legend|ja|凡例|zh|凡例|12=draft}} {| In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}} god name records but which are not listed in those records—the so‑called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a total of 21 groups comprising 1 major shrine group (dai-sha) and 20 minor shrine groups (shō-sha) are recorded. {{ill|List of Shikinaisha/Legend|de|List of Shikinaisha/Legend|ja|凡例|zh|凡例|12=draft}} {| In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}} god name records but which are not listed in those records—the so‑called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a total of 21 groups comprising 1 major shrine group (dai-sha) and 20 minor shrine groups (shō-sha) are recorded. {{ill|List of Shikinaisha/Legend|de|List of “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}} god name records but which are not listed in those records—the so‑called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}} god name records but which are not listed in those records—the so‑called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a total of 21 groups comprising 1 major shrine group (dai-sha) and 20 minor shrine groups (shō-sha) are recorded. {{ill|List of Shikinaisha/Legend|de|List of In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}} god name records but which are not listed in those records—the so‑called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a total of 21 groups comprising 1 major shrine group (dai-sha) and 20 minor shrine groups (shō-sha) are recorded. {{ill|List of Shikinaisha/Legend|de|List of In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}} god name records but which are not listed in those records—the so‑called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai Shrine|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}}”—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|12=draft}}, a total of 21 groups comprising 1 major shrine group (dai-sha) and 20 minor shrine groups (shō-sha) are recorded. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Tosa Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in Tosa Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Tosa Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. Or the list of shrines in Tosa Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Tosa Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in Tosa Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in Tosa Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Tosa Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Tosa Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. [[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[Category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Tosa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. Or the list of shrines in [[Tosa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 延喜式神名帳|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} of [[Tosa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Tosa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 21 Shikinaisha in the province – 20 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Tosa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 21 Shikinaisha in the province – 20 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Tosa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 21 Shikinaisha in the province – 20 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Tosa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 21 Shikinaisha in the province – 20 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Tosa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 21 Shikinaisha in the province – 20 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Tosa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 21 Shikinaisha in the province – 20 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Tosa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 21 Shikinaisha in the province – 20 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 21 Shikinaisha in the province – 20 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Tosa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 21 Shikinaisha in the province – 20 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Tosa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 21 Shikinaisha in the province – 20 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Tosa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 21 Shikinaisha in the province – 20 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Tosa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 21 Shikinaisha in the province – 20 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Tosa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 21 Shikinaisha in the province – 20 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Tosa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 21 Shikinaisha in the province – 20 Shikinai Shōsha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Tosa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 21 Shikinaisha in the province – 20 Shikinai Shōsha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Tosa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 21 Shikinaisha in the province – 20 Shikinai Shōsha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Tosa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 21 Shikinaisha in the province – 20 Shikinai Shōsha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Tosa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 21 Shikinaisha in the province – 20 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Tosa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 21 Shikinaisha in the province – 20 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.
